falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within the next 14 trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows would invalidate the 73% bottom pattern match, as that prior bottom held at ~4,800; this would prove the current structure is weaker and not a valid analog

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom featured VIX peaking near 28; sustained readings above 35 would indicate a panic regime beyond that bottom's stress level, proving this is not a comparable accumulation phase but rather a higher-volatility breakdown

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.50% within 14 days while S&P 500 simultaneously trades below its 20-day moving average
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This combination of flight-to-safety bid in bonds with equity weakness would signal recession/de-risking rather than the growth-scare-bottom dynamic of August 2024, where yields rose with equities stabilizing

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
